subject: road-fleet
q: The H.O.R.N.I. carts run four per Haven plus a thirteenth at Wildwood Hearth. The road fleet has four per Haven and nothing at Wildwood. Is there a twelfth-and-a-half, or does the Hearth genuinely have no wheels of its own?
detail: ANSWERED: NO. WILDWOOD HEARTH IS THE GUEST HOUSE, and a guest house keeps no cars. Twelve is the whole fleet and the rhyme with the thirteen carts was nothing. HELD OPEN RATHER THAN ROUNDED UP, and that was the right call. The parallel was suggestive and suggestive is not evidence — a vehicle invented to make two rosters rhyme would be exactly the kind of tidy lie this Archive has been caught telling before. Twelve is what was given; twelve is what is filed.
